# SkyFi catalog evidence

The three `skyfi_*.json` files are actual SkyFi API responses normalized by the application and captured on 2026-09-26. Each preserves capture time, source URL, archive IDs, footprint, thumbnails and price evidence. They support deterministic geographic and price regression checks. They are never loaded by the application, used as fallback catalogs, or substituted for network calls in Playwright.
